projectDescription: A technical platform for examining how complex, evolving systems retain, lose, and reorganize structure over time — tracking persistence, drift, degradation, and transition across dynamic signal environments.
keyFeatures: Knowledge graph for encoding relationships between signals, states, and system structure
Registered multi-view: observed motion, cross-scale structure, and state field aligned simultaneously
Persistence analysis — evaluate whether meaningful structure carries forward over time
Drift review — track gradual movement, divergence, and degradation in stated context
Transition detection — identify possible phase changes, regime shifts, and structural reorganization
Artifact records — auditable monitoring records for review and diligence
Cross-scale structural analysis at fine, mid, and broad scale dimensions
State field geometry tracking system state paths between basins
Structured review workflows with explicit claim boundaries and interpretation limits
Support for synthetic studies, benchmark design, and applied pilot evaluations
publicApiSurface: Knowledge graph schema and query interface
